subject: [PATCH] mm/vma: restore VMA iterator on full-range merge failure

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Expressed frustration with mass-driveby submissions that lack user-visible effects, causing unnecessary triage and attention for maintainers. Suggested the author consider the review time cost of each submission.

reviews.author: Shao Mingyin
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the maintainer's concerns and withdrew the patch, committing to change their submission process to include user-visible effects and reachable triggers.

2026-11-14.patch_summary: The patch to restore VMA iterator on full-range merge failure was withdrawn by the author after a maintainer expressed frustration with mass-driveby submissions and lack of user-visible effects.
